The structure of Li12Mn12O28 (reduced formula Li3Mn3O7) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63) with 52 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn centers with 4- and 5-coordinate oxygen environments, while Li centers adopt 3-, 4-, and 5-coordinate oxygen environments. Oxygen centers are coordinated by varying Li and Mn neighbor counts. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Li- and Mn-centered polyhedra, as well as corner-sharing between Li-centered polyhedra.
